description.en-US:
imo is a free international calling and messaging app that allows users to connect with friends and family through voice calls, video calls, and text messaging. Known simply as imo, this application is available for the Android platform and is designed to facilitate seamless communication across the globe. Users can download imo to engage in high-definition video calls or send instant messages without incurring any charges.

The app supports over 300 million video calls daily, enabling individuals to communicate in real-time, regardless of their geographical location. Users can initiate international calls without worrying about fees, making it a practical choice for those with connections around the world. The video call feature provides clear and high-quality visuals, ensuring that conversations feel natural and engaging. In addition to one-on-one conversations, imo allows for group video chats, helping friends and family stay connected even when they are apart.

imo's messaging capabilities extend beyond simple texts. Users can share photos, videos, and various file types including documents in formats such as .DOC, .MP3, .ZIP, and .PDF. This versatility enhances the communication experience, allowing users to share important moments and information easily. The app also includes a feature for sending voice messages, catering to users who prefer audio communication over text.

A significant aspect of imo is its ability to maintain reliability across different network conditions. The app functions effectively over 2G, 3G, 4G, and even 5G connections, as well as Wi-Fi. This means that users can stay connected even in areas with less stable internet, ensuring that important calls and messages are not missed. The consistent performance under various circumstances makes imo a dependable choice for international communication.

Privacy is a priority for imo users. The app incorporates multiple security features, including end-to-end encryption, which ensures that conversations remain private and secure. Users have control over their chat history with options to erase messages and set timers for message disappearance. Additional features such as the screen shield help protect against unauthorized access, enhancing the overall privacy of user interactions.

Moreover, imo supports instant message translation, allowing users to communicate without language barriers. This feature is particularly useful for those who wish to connect with friends or family who speak different languages. The translation capability facilitates smoother conversations, making it easier to share thoughts and ideas.

The app also includes a specialized VoiceClub feature, which allows users to create or join voice chat rooms. This social aspect of imo provides an avenue for individuals to meet new people and engage in discussions on various topics. VoiceClub can host events such as talent shows, talk shows, and competitions, providing entertainment and community engagement through voice communication.

For Muslims, imo offers a unique Hajj and Umrah assistant feature. This component assists users in navigating the processes associated with performing Umrah, offering tips and location sharing to enhance the experience. This feature aims to make the spiritual journey more accessible and secure for devotees.

In terms of cloud storage, imo provides users with a cloud service that allows for the secure syncing of message history and files. This capability helps to free up phone storage while ensuring that important conversations and documents are easily retrievable. Users can access their data from different devices without the worry of losing important information.

The app is designed to foster connection, making it easier for users to maintain relationships with loved ones, whether they are next door or on the other side of the globe. The combination of calling, messaging, and media sharing encapsulates the various ways in which individuals can stay in touch.

Given its comprehensive features, imo stands out as an effective communication tool for users looking to maintain connections across distances. With its focus on privacy, reliability, and user-friendly design, imo is a compelling option for anyone in need of a robust messaging and calling solution. Users can experience its wide range of functionalities by downloading imo and exploring its capabilities.

For more information, visit the official website: https://imo.im/
Privacy Policy: https://imo.im/policies/privacy_policy.html
Terms of Service: https://imo.im/policies/terms_of_service.html
Help & Feedback: https://activity.imoim.net/feedback/index.html

summary.en-US: An open-source file manager for Android: two panes, archives, APK and DEX editing, a code editor, network s…

description.en-US:
Strata is a free, open-source file manager for Android with the tools power users need: two panes, archives, APK and DEX editing, a code editor, network storages and an encrypted vault. No ads, no accounts, no tracking. Features

- Files: two panes side by side, drag and drop onto folders, root and Shizuku access, recycle bin, search by name or content, batch rename, bookmarks, permissions, links, split and merge, file encryption - Archives: open and extract ZIP, 7z, RAR, TAR, GZ, XZ, ZST and more; create ZIP, 7z and TAR archives with passwords - APK tools: app details, split APK install, signing (v1 to v3) and signing keys, clone with a new name and icon, DEX and smali editor, Java decompiler, manifest and resource editors - Editors and viewers: code editor with syntax highlighting, hex editor, PDF reader, image viewer, music and video player, font viewer, Markdown preview, 9-patch editor, color picker - Network: FTP, SFTP, SMB and WebDAV right in the panes, plus Wi-Fi sharing with an FTP server or a file manager in the browser - Code runner: run and build code in many languages through Termux - Privacy: an encrypted vault opened with your fingerprint, app lock, and nothing that leaves your phone unless you send it - Languages: English, Persian (fully right-to-left), Russian and Chinese - Design: Material 3 Expressive with dynamic colors, light and dark themes Building

You need the Android SDK with an NDK, and Rust with the Android targets and cargo-ndk. JDK 17 is set up by Gradle.

bash rustup target add aarch64-linux-android armv7-linux-androideabi x8664-linux-android cargo install cargo-ndk native/fetch-pdfium.sh native/build.sh ./gradlew :app:assembleDebug

Support the developer

Strata is free and open source. If it saves you time and you'd like to help it grow, you can send a donation to one of these addresses. Every bit of support is appreciated. Thank you!

summary.en-US: Bale is a financial and social messaging application developed by Bank Melli Iran, designed to facilitate c…

description.en-US:
Bale is a financial and social messaging application developed by Bank Melli Iran, designed to facilitate communication and banking services seamlessly. Available for the Android platform, users can download Bale to enjoy a blend of chat features and financial transactions within a single interface.

The app allows users to send various types of messages, including text, voice, video, and images. This versatility enables users to maintain personal connections and share multimedia content with family and friends easily. Bale also supports the creation of diverse channels, which can focus on news, entertainment, sports, and other topics, fostering community engagement and information sharing.

Users can establish groups with a capacity of up to 2,048 members, making it suitable for large communities or organizations. Bale provides options for creating both private and public channels, which can be utilized for content dissemination, business promotions, and charity initiatives. This feature encourages users to engage with a broader audience while promoting their interests or causes.

In addition to messaging capabilities, Bale includes a unique bot feature that enables users to create automated tools for various tasks, including financial transactions. This integration of bots simplifies processes, allowing for efficient management of tasks within the app. The platform also supports sticker creation, giving users the opportunity to personalize their communication experience with custom stickers.

Bale is not limited to messaging; it also offers a range of financial services. One of its notable functions is the ability to perform card-to-card transfers among banks participating in the Shetab network without needing the recipient's card number. Users simply need to mention the bank's name, streamlining the transfer process significantly.

The app supports the National Bank of Iran’s digital wallet, known as Jibam, providing users with easy access to a variety of banking services. This integration allows for actions such as opening accounts, managing loans, checking balances, and even seeking online banking advice without the necessity of visiting a physical branch.

Furthermore, Bale facilitates the purchase and sale of content, enabling users to buy internet packages, recharge their phones, and pay utility bills directly through the application. Users can pay for mobile, fixed-line, electricity, water, and gas bills, providing a comprehensive solution for managing their financial obligations.

The app also allows users to view their account balances and transaction history without incurring additional fees. This transparency helps users keep track of their financial activities more effectively. Additionally, the ability to request money linked to a bank card number is particularly useful for invoicing, charity collections, and other financial transactions.

Bale provides support for multiple languages, including Persian, Turkish, Arabic, and English, making it accessible to a wider audience. This multilingual capability ensures that users from different backgrounds can navigate the app and utilize its features comfortably.

For vehicle owners, Bale includes features for paying toll fees, traffic violation fines, and insurance premiums through its dedicated bot services. This integration simplifies the payment process for essential services, making it efficient and straightforward for users to manage their vehicle-related expenses.

The app's web version allows users to access their messages and perform banking tasks from a computer or laptop, offering flexibility in how users interact with the application. This multi-device support enables seamless transitions between devices, ensuring that users can stay connected and manage their finances conveniently.

With the night mode option, users can reduce eye strain during evening hours, enhancing their overall experience while using the app. The ability to access the application across different devices means that users can remain connected, whether they are using a mobile phone, tablet, or computer.

Bale combines the features of a social networking platform with practical banking services, making it a versatile tool for users in Iran. By integrating communication and financial management, the app caters to the diverse needs of its users, promoting ease of use and efficiency in daily transactions.

The multifaceted nature of Bale allows it to cater to various user needs, whether for personal communication or managing finances. The app's continuous updates and enhancements reflect its commitment to improving user experience and expanding its service offerings, ensuring that it remains relevant in the rapidly evolving digital landscape.

The features of Bale encapsulate a modern approach to financial transactions and social interaction, making it an essential app for individuals looking to simplify their communication and banking needs in one convenient location.
